name: line-arc-fillet
description: Quarter disc: line (0,0)-(40,0), arc r=40 about the origin to (0,40), line back; sketch Fillet r=5 between the bottom line and the arc at (40,0); extruded 10.

conventions.world: right-handed; Z up. XY/XZ/YZ are the origin planes.
conventions.sketch_frame: sketch-local 2D coords; world = plane.origin + x*plane.x_dir + y*plane.y_dir (origin in mm). Profile 'loops' list sketch entity ids.
conventions.point_refs: '<id>.start' / '<id>.end' / '<id>.center' reuse (share) that existing sketch point; 'at' is its position when referenced.
conventions.extrude_direction: positive = along sketch plane normal unless stated
conventions.selections: selected faces/edges carry 'point': a world-space point on the face / the edge's parametric midpoint; pick the nearest face/edge to it.
